privacy.title: AI privacy
privacy.subtitle: Controls whether real users' profile data may be sent to the AI provider (for example to write CVs).
privacy.statusLabel: Sending real users' profile data to the AI
privacy.blockedExplain: Blocked: only test accounts (fictional data) can use AI features that send profile data. Real users see a message that the feature is not available yet.
privacy.allowedExplain: Allowed: every user's profile data may be sent to the AI provider. Use only with a paid AI tier whose privacy terms were verified.
privacy.reasonHint: Required: why the setting is changed (10 to 500 characters).
privacy.confirmAllow: I confirm KOBANIQ uses a paid AI tier and the privacy requirements have been verified.
privacy.error: Could not load the setting. Check that the backend is running.
privacy.changeMessage: The setting goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Your reason is saved with your account and the time, and shown in the history and the audit log.
privacy.tooShort: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
privacy.tooLong: The reason can be at most 500 characters.

welcome.tagline:
Know Your Skills.
Find Your Opportunity.
welcome.body: AI-powered career intelligence: verify what you know, discover real jobs that fit, and build tailored CVs.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change it any time in Settings.

skills.title: Know what you actually know
skills.body: Take short adaptive quizzes to verify your skills — always optional. Results measure knowledge, not proof of real-world experience.

jobs.title: Real jobs, clearly explained
jobs.body: Search the job sources you choose in Somaliland, Somalia and remote. Every match tells you why it fits — and which skills are missing.
